parts.premise: this study showed that “challenging homework” significantly and positively impacted on students’ mathematics achievement at class level (Dettmers et al., 2010). At elementary school, homework quality (assessed through homework selection) predicted positively 6th-grade students’ homework effort, homework performance, and mathematics achievement (Rosário et al., 2018).
parts.hypothesis: A study shows that early elementary students receive too much homework.
